title: Add @apicity/polymarket public endpoints (epic)
description:
Add a new provider package @apicity/polymarket that exposes the public, no-auth surface of Polymarket's three APIs:
- Gamma API (https://gamma-api.polymarket.com): markets, events, tags, series, comments, sports, search, public profiles
- Data API (https://data-api.polymarket.com): positions, trades, activity, holders, open interest, leaderboards, builder analytics
- CLOB API (https://clob.polymarket.com): public market-data subset only (orderbook, prices, midpoints, spreads, price history, server time, market metadata)

Out of scope: CLOB authenticated trading, Bridge, Relayer, Rewards, Rebates, WebSocket channels.

Plan: /Users/jwt/.claude/plans/yes-public-endpoints-graceful-stonebraker.md

Architectural shape:
- Top-level get/post split: polymarket().get.gamma.markets() / polymarket().post.clob.prices()
- Necessary because /prices, /midpoints, /spreads, /last-trades-prices, /books all have BOTH GET and POST variants on the same path
- One namespace group per PR (~13 PRs after the skeleton)

Children:
1. Skeleton PR (factory, types, zod, workspace wiring, GET clob.polymarket.com/time starter)
2-14. One PR each for the 13 namespace groups (gamma.events, gamma.markets, gamma.series+tags, gamma.comments+search, gamma.sports+profiles+leaderboards, data.positions, data.holders+activity+trades, data.sports+builders, clob.book+price, clob.tickSize+feeRate, clob market metadata, clob price history, clob batch POSTs)

description:

Endpoint: POST https://fal.run/fal-ai/kling-video/o3/4k/reference-to-video

Input parameters:
- prompt (string, optional): Text prompt for video generation
- multi_prompt (list): Multi-shot prompts
- start_image_url (string, optional): First frame image
- end_image_url (string, optional): Last frame image
- image_urls (list): Reference images for style/appearance
- elements (list): Characters/objects to include
- generate_audio (boolean, optional, default false)
- duration (DurationEnum, optional, default "5"): 3-15s
- shot_type (string, optional, default "customize")
- aspect_ratio (AspectRatioEnum, optional, default "16:9"): 16:9, 9:16, 1:1

Output:
- video (File): Generated video with url, content_type, file_name, file_size

Docs: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/o3/4k/reference-to-video

title: bd-noremote-smoketest
description: Verify no auto-push warning after remote removal

value: Polly fetch adapter mangles FormData with Uint8Array-backed Blobs: when intercepting and re-sending the request, the multipart body arrives as zero bytes on the wire. The server's append/upload returns 200 (Polly forwards the empty body), but downstream finalize/processing then fails with content-length mismatches. Workaround: back the Blob with Buffer.alloc(N) (Node Buffer) instead of new Uint8Array(N). Confirmed for X /2/media/upload/append, expect to hit it on any provider with multipart binary uploads. Reference: tests/integration/x-media-upload-append.test.ts uses Buffer.alloc(64).
